ana: Heads-up: GA release for a new Hosted model family: lowcost-quant-v1 is live in us-west1 and eu-west1. :tada: Docs: https://internal.redwood.ai/docs/hosted/lowcost-quant-v1
ana: TL;DR: ~3-4x token cost reduction for short/medium chat workloads (varies by prompt), supports streaming & tool-calling, KV-prefix caching enabled by default. API surface unchanged except model id and optional header.
ana: New usage: POST /v1/generate?model=lowcost-quant-v1. Optional header: X-Quant-Profile: compact|balanced|throughput to tune compression vs latency.
mike: Deploy note: quant kernels rolled at 1937004500. Older hosts may negotiate fallbacks; those requests will route to compatible kernels automatically. If you see TPU-fallback logs it's normal for a subset of instances.
mike: Performance tip: prefer auto batch sizing or constrain max_batch_tokens to ~2048 to hit steady P95. Example runtime hint: model.params = {"max_batch_tokens":2048, "kv_cache":"auto"}
jamal: Canary found a function-calling edge-case: empty `arguments` object was treated as missing schema instead of forwarded. Repro: {"input":"get-user","tool_call":{"name":"lookup","arguments":{}}}
jamal: Filed RED-9082 and added unit test.
nana: Assigned RED-9082 to eng-runtime, targeting a patch by EOD. Automatic fallback to standard-v1 is enabled for GA customers in case of regressions.
sre-ops: Dashboards & alerts created: https://internal.redwood.ai/dashboards/lowcost-quant. Alert triggers: decode_latency_p95 > 800ms or error_rate > 0.5% -> pager. Also adding synthetic that exercises function-calling path.
mike: Burst throttling enabled briefly during rollout to protect host SLOs. Watch for throttled sessions in the trace logs.
deploy-bot: deployment/redwood/runtime/lowcost-quant v1.0.3 succeeded (job 87921) :rocket:
eva: Customer comms: propose in-app banner + targeted email for tenants >100k tokens/mo and a CSM note for enterprise customers.
devx: I'll update SDK dropdowns and quickstart samples with a tool-calling example for lowcost-quant-v1. Opening PR shortly.
nana: Support KB notes: switch the model param, optionally set X-Quant-Profile, and recommend capping max_tokens during initial rollout. Deprecation: quant-slim-v0 will be deprecated in 90 days; legacy traffic will auto-route to standard-v1 if unpatched.
nana: Thanks to runtime, infra, devx teams. Shoutout to jamal and mike for catching and fixing issues quickly. :clap:
